params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: Resize horizontal none: neither width nor position changes when the window widens.
Resize horizontal grow: the object's width grows proportionally with the window.
Resize horizontal move: the object is moved (not resized) proportionally with the window's width growth.
Resize vertical none: neither height nor position changes when the window heightens.
Resize vertical grow: the object's height grows proportionally with the window.
Resize vertical move: the object is moved (not resized) proportionally with the window's height growth.

overloads.semanticRole: The OBJECT GET RESIZING OPTIONS command returns the current resizing options for the object(s) designated by the object and * parameters for the current process.
